page_title: REN 4-1 STR | Rennes v Strasbourg 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
90+5' Strasbourg earn a corner.
90+5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Strasbourg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+5' A yellow card for a tackle by Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes). Thomas Leonard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+4' Rabby Nzingoula (Strasbourg) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90+3' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+3' Strasbourg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+3' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+3' Substitution. Esteban Lepaul walks off the pitch and Lucas Rosier (Rennes) comes on as a substitute.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
85' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Diego Moreira is replaced by Martial Godo (Strasbourg).
83' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Julio Enciso as he is replaced by Kendry Paez (Strasbourg).
83' The foul by Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Thomas Leonard.
81' Strasbourg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
77' 4 - 1 Goal! Valentin Barco provides Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 4:1.
76' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
74' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
71' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
69' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
69' The ball is out of play. Strasbourg will have a chance to score from a corner.
68' Habib Beye has decided to make a change. Ludovic Blas (Rennes) replaces Djaoui Cisse.
68' Today's match ends for Mohamed Meite who will be replaced by Breel Embolo (Rennes).
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.
65' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
61' Liam Rosenior has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rabby Nzingoula (Strasbourg) replacing Abdoul Ouattara.

60' 4 - 0 It's a goal! Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the top right corner. The assist goes to Valentin Rongier and the score changes to 4:0.
59' A substitution has been made. Mousa Tamari goes off and Quentin Merlin (Rennes) comes on.
59' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
58' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range low towards the middle of the net, but Brice Samba was alert and made an amazing save!

54' This would have been a magnificent goal from Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg), who collected the ball inside the box and prodded a first-time shot on goal that flew just narrowly wide of the right post.
54' The game is interrupted as Mousa Tamari (Rennes) is flagged offside.
53' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
52' Liam Rosenior has decided to substitute Samuel Amo-Ameyaw and he is replaced by Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg).
52' It will be a substitution. Mathis Amougou (Strasbourg) is ready to enter the pitch as Samir El Mourabet walks off.
50' Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) missed a big chance! He produces a stunning volley from inside the box, but his effort goes not far wide of the right post.
48' 3 - 0 Goal! Mohamed Meite passes the ball to the feet of Esteban Lepaul (Rennes), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 3:0.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
45+1' Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches wide of the right post.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Flag goes up against Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
39' The shot by Valentin Rongier (Rennes) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Mike Penders.
38' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
38' Rennes take a short corner kick.

38' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the top right corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Mike Penders, who pulls off a stunning save! Rennes force a corner. They send men into the box.
37' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
35' 2 - 0 GOAL! Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Mohamed Meite (Rennes) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 2:0.
34' The ball is out of play and Rennes manage to earn a corner.
34' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
32' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Thomas Leonard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
28' Valentin Rongier (Rennes) trips an opposition player and Thomas Leonard signals a foul.
26' The linesman raises his flag. Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) is adjudged offside.
26' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but Brice Samba comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block.
21' Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
20' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
18' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
17' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
16' Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
14' Rennes fail to score from a corner as Mike Penders (Strasbourg) leaps to collect the ball.

13' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Rennes.
13' Rennes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

12' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Rennes force their opponents to concede a corner.

9' 1 - 0 Mousa Tamari sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
8' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) misses a great opportunity from inside the penalty area after blasting the ball towards goal and it goes wide of the left post.
6' Lilian Brassier (Rennes) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
4' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
1' The match has just started.
Rennes will kick the game off.
Thomas Leonard will supervise the game today.
